title: Martin High Students Pie Teachers in the Face for HOSA Fundraiser
excerpt: Martin High School students got the chance to hit their teachers in the face with whipped cream pies in a “Pie a Teacher in the Face Day” fundraiser, with all proceeds going to the campus HOSA group.
content:
Students at Martin High School in Laredo got the chance to pie their teachers in the face — literally — in a “Pie a Teacher in the Face Day” fundraiser.

Students hit staff members, including two administrators, in the face with whipped cream pies as part of the fundraiser. All proceeds went to the campus HOSA group, with most of the money earmarked for an end-of-year trip.

The amount raised and the price per pie were not stated.
